mapper.select: SELECT mg.group_name, m.material_name FROM material_group mg JOIN material m ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id ORDER BY mg.material_group_id, m.material_name;

SELECT ws.stock_no AS stockNo, ws.material_code AS materialCode, ws.qty AS currentQty, DATE_FORMAT(ws.received_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS receivedAt, DATE_FORMAT(ws.expiry_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expiryDate, ws.status AS status,
m.material_name AS materialName, m.unit AS unit,
mg.group_name AS category
FROM warehouse_stock ws
JOIN material m ON ws.material_code = m.material_code JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id
AND mg.group_name = #{categoryName}
AND m.material_name = #{itemName}
AND ( ws.stock_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR mg.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY ws.received_at DESC

SELECT ws.stock_no AS stockNo, ws.material_code AS materialCode, ws.qty AS currentQty, DATE_FORMAT(ws.received_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS receivedAt, DATE_FORMAT(ws.expiry_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expiryDate, ws.status AS status,
m.material_name AS materialName, m.unit AS unit,
mg.group_name AS category
FROM warehouse_stock ws
JOIN material m ON ws.material_code = m.material_code JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id WHERE ws.stock_no = #{stockNo}

SELECT change_type AS changeType, change_amount AS changeAmount, after_qty AS afterQty, DATE_FORMAT(changed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS changedAt
FROM warehouse_stock_change_history
WHERE stock_no = #{stockNo}
ORDER BY changed_at DESC
